name: Groundnut (Peanut)
soilType: Light sandy loam, well-drained red sandy soil with loose texture
growthTips: Apply Gypsum @ 200 kg/acre at 40-45 days (pegging stage) for healthy pod filling and shell hardness.
Treat seeds with Rhizobium and Trichoderma cultures before sowing.

commonDiseases.name: Tikka Disease (Leaf Spot)
symptoms: Circular reddish-brown with prominent yellow halo
Dark brown to black spots on underside of leaf
organicTreatment: Soil application of Trichoderma viride enriched FYM
prevention: Proper seed treatment with Thiram + Carbendazim (1:1)

name: Sugarcane
soilType: Deep rich loam, black soil with good drainage and water table > 1.5m
growthTips: Trash mulching between cane rows conserves moisture and suppresses weed growth.
Earthing up at 90 and 120 days prevents lodging during monsoon storms.

commonDiseases.name: Red Rot of Sugarcane
Colletotrichum falcatum
High
name: Third or fourth leaf from top shows yellowing and withering
Split open stalks show reddened internal tissues with white transverse bands
Fermentation sour odor from affected canes
Infected seed setts and waterlogged soil conditions
Hot water sett treatment (50°C for 2 hours)
Apply Trichoderma viride enriched pressmud @ 2 tonnes/acre
Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L sett dip treatment for 15 minutes before planting
Use certified disease-free nursery seed setts
Do not ratoon severely infected sugarcane fields
Ensure proper field drainage
Potato
soilType: Loose, friable sandy loam rich in humus (pH 5.5 - 6.5)
growthTips: Earthing up at 30 days after planting is crucial to prevent greening of tubers by sunlight.
Stop irrigation 10-12 days before harvest to harden the tuber skin.

commonDiseases.name: Late Blight of Potato
Phytophthora infestans
High
name: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaf tips and margins
White mildew growth on leaf undersides in morning dew
Decaying tubers with reddish-brown dry rot
High humidity (>90%) with cool temperature (15-20°C)
Bordeaux mixture 1% spray before onset of foggy weather
Bio-fungicide Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5g/L
Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L
Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/L water
Plant certified seed tubers (Kufri Pukhraj, Kufri Jyoti)
Dehaulm (cut foliage) 10 days before harvesting
